Findings.Title: SQL query built via string concatenation or fmt.Sprintf
Findings.Evidence: query := "SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE name = '" + name + "'"
Findings.Recommendation: Use parameterized queries (db.Query/Exec with ? placeholders) or prepared statements to prevent SQL injection.

Findings.Title: Goroutine started without a visible exit condition
Findings.Recommendation: Pass a context.Context to the goroutine and select on ctx.Done() to ensure it can be cancelled.

Findings.Title: defer Close() was removed, resource may leak on error paths
Findings.Recommendation: Restore defer f.Close() immediately after the open call to ensure the resource is released on all exit paths.

Findings.Title: Possible ignored error from bare function call
Findings.Recommendation: If this function returns an error, assign it to a variable and check it. If it is void, consider adding a comment to clarify.

Findings.Title: Hardcoded secret or credential in source code
Findings.Recommendation: Load secrets from environment variables, a secrets manager, or a config file excluded from version control.

Findings.Title: Database transaction without defer Rollback()
Findings.Recommendation: Add defer tx.Rollback() immediately after Begin to ensure the transaction is rolled back on error paths. A rolled-back committed transaction is a no-op.
